caption:
Google killed a feature many businesses still rely on.

The chat inbox and call-history log inside Google Business Profile are gone for good. No setting brings them back.

That means when a customer calls and hangs up, nothing inside your profile catches it. The miss disappears.

The fix takes one setup this week: route your Google number through a trackable line, then turn on automatic text-back for every missed call. The lead gets a text in seconds, whether Google logs the call or not.

See it running on your own number. 14 days free.
